about_the_game:
The 90s are back! In pog form

P.O.G.S. – Power of Golden Slammer is a game about being a kid in the 90s during the pogs craze!



Power of Golden Slammer is about riding your skateboard around different parts of town, winning and losing pogs battling other kids, mowing lawns to earn money to buy more pogs at the video store and collecting rad items like electronic LCD handheld games, slap bracelets and wearable items which increase your coolness! 

Authentic POGS BATTLES

You may be wondering “How does a pogs battle actually work in P.O.G.S.?” To summarize, the player and the opponent take turns slamming a stack of pogs with their slammer and keep whichever pogs flip over on their turn. 

For the player this means either doing a normal slam by clicking the “SLAM” button as it appears or using your one shot SPECIAL SLAM to attempt using the power of leverage to get a really sweet payout. This technique was so powerful it was often outlawed! But P.O.G.S. is still the wild west. 

Make no mistake however the SPECIAL SLAM can cost you dearly if you are too greedy and attempt to lever too many caps or can be wasted if you wait to use it when there are only a few caps remaining. Using the SPECIAL SLAM properly requires some amount of strategy and skill to time the drop while your GOLDEN SLAMMER is angled just right.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD RADEON R5, 2500 Mhz 4 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R5 Graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: AMD High Definition Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: These are the current minimum specs similar to a laptop tested to run the Lite build of POGS (POGS Lite) which uses a much lighter rendering method than the standard build.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700, 3901 Mhz 8 Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek High Definition Audio
  • Additional Notes: These are specs similar to those used in development of the game and may be much higher than necessary.

short_description: A third-person first-person simulation of the 90s featuring authentic turn based pogs battles, skateboarding, mini quests and fun wearable items.
